verdict.rationale: The pack only glancingly touches cross-team coordination. There is a Jira Cloud Data Sync pitched as boosting visibility between technical and non-technical teams, one- or two-way sync between Asana projects and other tools, status-update reporting via the API, and AI Teammates marketed for "coordination-heavy work". Nothing documents dependency tracking itself. Missing for 10: native task/project dependency linking, cross-project dependency views (timeline/portfolio), blocking/waiting-on alerts, launch-level rollups, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
